headline: Argentine Equities Fall as Oil Prices Slump in New York Trading
summary: Argentine shares dropped in New York trading on November 4, led by a 7.1% decline in YPF and a 5.4% drop in Pampa Energía amid a broader oil slump, while the peso held near 1,548 per dollar.
why: Energy-dependent emerging market equities react directly to global commodity price trends, particularly crude oil benchmarks impacting domestic resource producers.

impacts.name: YPF
impacts.why: Lower global crude prices diminish revenue expectations for oil producers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A drop in global crude prices directly pressures the valuation of oil-linked emerging market asset equities.
